label: Pearl & Mint
description: Deep teal-blue with a fresh mint accent on a cool pearl page. Clean and reassuring without the cold, corporate feel of a hospital palette — suits dental clinics, orthodontics and aesthetic practices.
notes: Tokens only — sections read these as CSS variables and never hardcode a colour. EVERY value here was derived by darkening along its own hue until it cleared 4.5:1 on BOTH the page and the cards, because `accent` is what the renderer paints 12px meta text with in ~15 places. A true mint (#16A085) measures 2.9:1 on white and is unreadable there, which is exactly the fault clinical-teal shipped with (accent 3.12:1 on bg). Do not lighten these back toward the original hues without re-measuring.
